programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una hermosa princesa resulta transformada en una bruja y necesita los bigotes de un gato y la lágrima de un Pitufo para preparar una poción mágica. Azrael, Pitufo Gruñón y Pitufo Bromista se convierten en colaboradores involuntarios y, cuando se produce la transformación mágica, la princesa les libera y regresan felices a su hogar.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Pitufos Leñadores
programme.desc: Un grupo de codiciosos leñadores planea talar el bosque del rey Gerard mientras se encuentra de vacaciones lejos de allí. Papá Pitufo disfraza a los Pitufos de fantasmas para espantar a los leñadores, que se rinden voluntariamente ante el rey cuando este regresa con su séquito.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Hay Que Atrapar Al Ladrón
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Ómnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladrón es entregado al magistrado y el joven está encantado de irse a vivir con Ómnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan ocupados demostrando su propia fuerza de voluntad que no se dan cuenta de que Gargamel ha capturado a Pitufo Armonía. Papá Pitufo ofrece a Gargamel una caja con trampa para poner a prueba su fuerza de voluntad, lo que permite escapar a Pitufo Armonía.

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: El Mejor Amigo De Vanidoso
programme.desc: Para Pitufo Vanidoso, no hay ningún espectáculo más fabuloso ni nada más satisfactorio que contemplarse a sí mismo. Cuando se topa con un diablillo adulador, está seguro de que ha encontrado a su mejor amigo para toda la vida. Pero las cosas no siempre son tan sencillas, ya que los amigos pueden meterte en problemas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los días la misma rutina, las mismas tareas, la misma vida… Pitufina está aburrida de todo eso. ¿No sería mucho más divertida una travesía en barco por alta mar? Y resulta que Pitufo Soñador está planeando un crucero. ¿Acaso no suena como el mismísimo paraíso?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se sobrecalienta tras el impacto de un rayo. Papá Pitufo tiene que apresurarse para enfriarlo antes de que se queme. Aun así, Pitufo Robotín utiliza su último voltio de energía para salvar a los Pitufos de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Gorjeos De Smoogle
programme.desc: Clorhidris planea transformar la primavera en la estación más infeliz del año. Atrapa el Azulejo de la Felicidad y lo transforma en un estruendoso cuervo. Cualquiera que oiga el canto del Cuervo de la Infelicidad se volverá infeliz. Solo Gruñón puede salvar la primavera.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una misión para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los Pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extraño capricho de la naturaleza. Papá Pitufo y los demás conseguirán liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolverá su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Una Brujita No Tan Mala
programme.desc: Mientras hacen un recado para Papá Pitufo en el conservatorio de las brujas, las pequeñas criaturas azules conocen a una diminuta bruja y le enseñan cómo ser buena; al mismo tiempo, hacen que otra bruja pierda sus poderes maléficos durante un año al caer en el río.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Las Nuevas Colinas Pitufas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar cuando Gargamel consigue que su libro de hechizos conjure un nuevo lugar más hermoso para que los Pitufos vivan en él: ¡un lugar perfecto para que pueda tenderles una trampa!

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos ayudan a una reina de las hadas a vencer al malvado Falan, que intenta robar el sonajero mágico de su hijo.

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel quiere crear un monstruo. Una criatura horrible y gigantesca, ¡un ser imponente que destruya a todos los Pitufos! Pero Gargamel comete un pequeño error y el resultado les dejará asombrados a su gato Azrael y a él.

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento de Pitufo Carpintero, la cámara de fotos pitufomática, parece el tipo de objeto capaz de reemplazar el pausado arte de Pitufo Pintor. Sin embargo, las fotos aéreas de la Aldea Pitufa tomadas por Pitufo Carpintero caen en manos de Gargamel. La única esperanza de los Pitufos es lograr confundirlo.

programme.title: Así Es La Vida
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos gritan a Pitufo Carpintero cuando sus inventos se estropean, por lo que decide abandonar la aldea. Pero, cuando Gargamel usa las máquinas abandonadas por Pitufo Carpintero para atrapar Pitufos, Pitufo Carpintero se da cuenta de que no puede abandonar a sus amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo se convierte por accidente en rey de los Trokels. Cuando Pitufo Filósofo comienza a dar órdenes en lugar de hacer lo que los Trokels quieren, deciden destronarle… lo que para ellos significa arrojarle por un precipicio. Pitufo Filósofo aprende que ser un líder significa mucho más que dar órdenes.

programme.title: El Cachorro De Papi
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza hace que Puppy pierda la memoria. Gargamel lo encuentra y decide entrenarlo para cazar Pitufos. Juntos, logran atrapar a los Pitufitos. Pero Gargamel da otro golpe a Puppy en la cabeza y este recuerda quiénes son sus verdaderos amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Namibia : The Pearl Of Africa

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel goes to new heights by traveling to the high altitude, capital city of Quito, Ecuador. While there Raw Travel explores the city's old cobblestone streets and historical architecture. Then it's off to the outskirts of the city to visit the Foundation for the Honor of Life School.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel takes viewers on a fascinating cultural journey by bus through one of South America's smallest, but most eco-friendly and culturally colorful countries. The producers travel from Quito to the eco-friendly and adventurous retreat of Baños to bike through some of most beautiful scenery in Latin America and partake in some of the regions many adventure sports.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Visiting the Caribbean while staying off the beaten path is not always easy, but the twin islands of Trinidad and Tobago (or T&T) are probably a Raw Traveler's best shot. Trinidad is famous for its carnival celebration and Raw Travel gets the lowdown with the National Carnival Band Association.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Rob gets a driving lesson on the 'wrong' side of the road as the crew goes against the grain by renting a car to explore rural areas of the island of Trinidad. After a few scary moments, they are able to show viewers the unique melting pot of cultures and religions that make up the islands cultural identity.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel invites viewers to forget everything they think they know about Colombia and join the Raw Travel team as they take the audience on a rare and unique look at the new, the real, Colombia.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Traveling through rural Colombia was once unthinkable, but today, Colombia's exotic countryside is an undiscovered gem, just waiting to entice travelers with its siren song. We begin on Colombia's coast with an off the beaten path and rare look at the remote village of San Basilio de Palenque.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: In Buenos Aires, Raw Travel digs deep to take viewers inside the rather large underground music and tattoo scene. Rob learns how to tango like a pro, well almost then heads to a soccer match to get an inside look at how the sport takes on near religious fervor in these parts.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel explores outside the capital city of Buenos Aires to experience some authentic gaucho culture in the tranquil town of San Antonio de Areco and then it's on to Estancia El Cencerro, a working ranch that hosts travelers from all over the world.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel takes viewers south, way down south in South America, to experience a small country with a surprisingly big and diverse melting pot of culture, Uruguay. The Raw Travel crew begins the journey in the large.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel takes viewers on an insider’s tour of one of the largest, most chaotic, misunderstood and intriguing cities in the world, Mexico City. From ancient Aztec culture to the wonders of the huge El Chopo Market and Mexico City's underground culture and Lucha Libre, get ready to see Mexico City, unmasked!

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Lack of infrastructure be damned, Nicaragua has put its civil war and troubled past behind and is welcoming travelers to experience it’s countless and undiscovered natural wonders. Join the crew as we make our way from earthquake ravaged Managua to the beautiful outposts of León, Granada, Estelí & Lake Omotepe and see why Nicaragua is the hottest up and coming destination in Central America.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Mexico’s Caribbean coast is a haven for raw travelers and traditional tourists alike. From swanky resorts with pulsating nightlife to bare bones eco-touristic getaways, isolated jungles and ancient ruins, the Yucatan is a natural wonder full of contrasts. See the Yucatan, Cancun & Playa del Carmen like you’ve never seen them before.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: For decades Costa Rica has been luring surfers and eco-travelers to experience its killer waves on the coasts and its unique bio-diversity in the rain forest. We find out why travelers, from first timers to hard core veterans, consistently rave about Costa Rica, Latin America’s undisputed eco-tourism champion. There will be zip-lining (of course!), wild crocodile feeding, bat cave touring, snake handling and a whole lot more!

programme.title: Top 10 İstanbul
programme.desc: Istanbul is a city that everyone admire; a city that has been an inspiration to poets, painters and authors for thousands of years. A city that has not been fully described, even though there are countless attraction points in Istanbul. Let us discover the 10 most popular sites including Topkapi Palace, Hagiasophia Mosque, Galata Tower, The Maiden's Tower and The Grand Bazaar.

programme.title: Taipei, Modern Face of Asia
programme.desc: This documentary explores Taipei, a city that embodies the modern face of Asia. From its towering skyscrapers and bustling night markets to its serene temples and natural hot springs, Taipei is a vibrant and diverse metropolis that seamlessly blends tradition and modernity. With a focus on the city’s unique cultural offerings and vibrant street life, this film provides a fascinating glimpse into the heart of one of Asia’s most dynamic and captivating cities.

programme.desc: A great day of Fall Fishing on Kenogamissi Lake with a young inspiring Angler.

programme.title: FishON | Spring Walleye
programme.desc: Spring walleye fishing on Kenogamissi Lake. A friendly husband vs wives challenge.

programme.title: Catching Bass | New Spin on Finesse
programme.desc: Dustin uses cool new bait to help catch finicky bass

programme.title: FishON! | Storm’s Edge Success: Fishing Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Join us as we head to Frederick House Lake in Connaught, Ontario, just east of Timmins. With a narrow window of opportunity before the weather closes in, we reel in some fantastic walleye, sauger, and other exciting species. It's all about adapting to the elements and making the most of the moment!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | A Fisherman's Paradise: Stoked on Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Join Stoked On Fishing as we embark on a thrilling 6-day fishing expedition to the enchanted Island of Puerto Rico. Nestled along the west coast, we'll be based in the charming fishing town of La Pargueta and fishing along the west coast locations of Cabo Rojo and Rincon. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with wide-open offshore and inshore fishing. Stoked On Puerto Rico

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | The Perfect Hair Jig Rod
programme.desc: Jim shows you how to build a hair jig rod, with detailed instruction from one of his Signature Series rod kits.

programme.title: Jarrett Edwards Outdoors — Fishing in the Deep
programme.desc: Jarrett and good friend Les Butters team up to tackle some deepwater largemouth bass in St. George Utah

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Cedros Island Goes Off, Part Two
programme.desc: We're returning to one of our all-time favorite destinations in Baja, Mexico - Cedros Island, with Jose and Cedros Outdoor Adventures. People often ask us, 'Why do you return to Cedros Island?' The answer is straightforward: the fishing is absolutely ridiculous almost every single time. Our Stoked on Fishing charter makes a point of showing up in the middle of October for a reason. That reason? It's all about the variety of species available to catch, starting with yellowfin tuna, dorado, halibut, and the elusive Mr. Yellowtail. It's game time - let's go fishing in Baja!

programme.title: Hook 'n Look — Which Way Did They Go?
programme.desc: Tournament veteran and fishing guide, Art Ferguson accompanies Kim in the Orlando area, in search of giant pre-spawn Florida largemouth. However, the two experience a baffling conundrum, which Kim documents from beneath the water's surface.

programme.title: Hank Parker Fishing
programme.desc: Fishing legend Hank Parker take viewers to the most secluded locations for the biggest fish.

programme.title: Catching Bass | New Spin on Finesse
programme.desc: Dustin uses cool new bait to help catch finicky bass

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors
programme.desc: Larry fishes with some military vets for a walleye grand slam.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - All About Swimbaits
programme.desc: This episode is all about Swimbaits, perhaps the most versatile tool in the tackle box for catching just about everything that swims.

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Finding Walleye
programme.desc: On today's episode of AnglingBuzz TV, we're talking all about finding walleye and how to catch them! Our special guest is Jason Freed who's a fishing guide on Minnesota's famous Leech Lake.

programme.title: Pro Vs Joe - Fishing giant bass at Camelot Bell
programme.desc: Brent Chapman delivers top tips on how to catch the biggest fish in the best spots.

programme.title: Pro vs Joe - Father Son Challenge
programme.desc: Brent Chapmans Pro vs Joe Father Son Challenge Part 1

programme.title: Stoked On Fishing
programme.desc: A few years back, three guys went fishing, but that just wasn't any day of fishing. Just when you least expected it, Matt Newman caught his personal best-spotted bass, and a few minutes later, Paul Bailey caught the World Record Spotted Bass that weighed 11.5 on four different scales. The nation went bonkers. Today those three same guys are going fishing again at one of the world's best bass fishing lakes. Welcome to Clear Lake!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake
programme.desc: Going camping and trout fishing in the Sierras is one of our favorite things to do. For the first time, Shea McIntee and the crew head down to South Lake Bishop. What makes this trip unique is that we get to fish with some good friends.

programme.desc: As fall grips Northern Ontario, unpredictable weather makes fishing a true test of patience and perseverance. Paul is joined by young angler Matthew, who’s finishing university and weighing the decision to stay in the North. Facing extreme cold on their first attempt, the duo regroup and return a few days later to a new lake, chasing walleye and capturing the stunning wilderness that makes Northern Ontario a fall angler’s paradise.

programme.title: FishON! | Experience Fishing at Ole's Adventure Lodge
programme.desc: Join us as we travel to Ole's Adventure Lodge on the picturesque Whitefish Lake, just west of Thunder Bay, Ontario. In this special episode, we shine a spotlight on the Experience Fishing program, dedicated to introducing the joys of angling to children, new Canadians, and women. Witness the excitement of first-time fishing adventures in a breathtaking setting that inspires connection with nature and community.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Looking for the most reliable broadheads for your next hunt? In this episode, Mike & Shawn break down 3 different types of G5 Broadheads — one of the most trusted names in bowhunting. Whether you’re chasing whitetails, elk, or anything in between, G5 broadheads are known for their durability, accuracy, and devastating performance.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade takes Bentley on his very first duck hunt. Slade also gets to take a trip to duck hunting paradise with some great buddies of his. This episode is all about having a great time with great friends.

Shan Twit's dedication to bowhunting finally pays off in Kentucky when he arrows his first Boone and Crockett buck. Years of hard work, scouting, and persistence culminate in this dream hunt through the rolling hills of the Bluegrass State. Watch as Shan's patience and skill come together for the shot of a lifetime.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Ryan bowhunts Saskatchewan for his first full velvet whitetail.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Axis deer have always been an opportunity for Will Cooper—but never the main pursuit. In Chasing Spots, Will heads to Central Texas to hunt free-range Axis deer for the first time alongside good friend Casey Sanford. Hunting the opening of the Axis rut, the two battle summer heat, and cover miles of Texas Hill-Country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Late October is one of the best times of the season to make a move, and Owen Reigler with Midwest Whitetail did just that on a great Iowa buck he calls the 6x6. With an active scrape line, an untouched clover plot, and a good idea of how the buck was using the area, Owen puts together the pieces for a perfect late-October setup.

programme.title: Browning Films
programme.desc: Ralph’s Iowa buck dreams come true, in a big way, in the last hour of his hunt.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: In this episode, we're headed out to Oklahoma to follow along with the Sharp brothers as they hunt whitetails in their home state. You never know what to expect with these two but one thing you can always rely on is that they always have some big deer to go after!

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour take ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Evan Williams from Hoyt and Tyler Jordan hit the mountains of Colorado in search of rutting Mule Deer with their bows, but the hunt takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand. Everything comes together in a heart-pounding moment that bow hunters dream about.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Opening Day of Deer Season 2023 is finally here and the Realtree Road Trips crew is ready to hit the whitetail woods bow hunting in Nebraska. It's unseasonably hot but the bucks are still hitting the fields before dark. Follow along daily as the guys chase these Nebraska monster bucks!!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts his farm in Georgia and tags out on a beautiful 10 pointer using the Franchi .308.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Greg Camp knocks down a monster whitetail in Nebraska on a crisp morning hunt. He gets it done in grand fashion.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Dink Watson and Sheldon Lye of New Zealand Hunting Adventures host Tyler Jordan on an unforgettable turkey hunt in New Zealand. This hunt isn’t just about incredible action, it’s about conservation, perception, and the future of the wild turkey.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts one of the biggest bucks on Realtree Farms with his brother Colton. Colton and his Dad Bill, have seen this buck several times over the last few days not he and Tyler make a move hoping to get Colton a shot at this giant Georgia whitetail.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma getting the Oklahoma turkey season kicked off.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at the Raven in Missouri trying to take advantage of some dry weather and get some Big Tine borderline planted and check off a long list of other summer time prep work as opening day of deer season will be here before we know it.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and the crew are finishing up the last of the food plots on the Raven and then the Tikka rifles come out as we fast forward to rifle camp at the Raven. Nate is able to catch up with a dandy of a buck and Randy's dad Travis also known as “Big Haus” is able to catch up with a fine Missouri buck of his own.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Southards are heads to Table Rock for the annual family vacation. Receding water poses a challenge but there’s no lack of fish or laughs at the lake!

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Richard Black for an exciting adventure in Key Largo, catching a wide variety of fish species on the shallow reef.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Jeff Malone to find a frenzy of exciting Bluefish near Marathon, FL.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Jeff Malone to find a productive wreck with which they enjoy the exciting variety of fish that wrecks can provide.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by marine scientist Nick Castillo to search for bonefish in Key Largo for both fun and study.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take a trip to the Marathon, FL area to challenge some feisty sharks and sneaky snook.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Captain Mike travels to the "Forgotten Coast" to fish Keaton Beach for the first time with the legendary Captain Greg DeVault.

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal
programme.desc: Go to Tamarack Island and catch Muskies - that’s the plan!

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny meets up with a local rally cars fabricator who takes him fishing. Ryan and his kids show Danny a thing or two about trolling on the lake.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: A day of fishing doesn't go exactly as planned when the weather takes a turn, but Josh and his family make the most of it, finishing the day with fresh fish on the grill at a family cookout.

programme.title: Silver Kings
programme.desc: Capt. Jared Raskob and Capt. Mike Alfano have a big surprise for Mike’s Dad, Randy.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA returns to his old stomping grounds, chasing legend in familiar waters. Giants still roam here and feed on the smallest of offerings.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Captain C.A. heads to Brownsville, Texas, to chase trout and redfish with well-known local guide Captain Ernest Cisneros.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny joins True North Trout and Koz as they hit the Manistee River for a bit of trout fishing on the fly.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: With Meredith McCord halfway around the world, Capt. Justin Leake gives show producer Chris Hermans his first shot at landing a tarpon after filming them for 9 seasons. Does art imitate life?

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends on board the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. This trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the skilled captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: "Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor patiently pursue big tarpon from the Everglades to the Middle Keys with fly rod in hand."

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Richard Black for an exciting adventure in Key Largo, catching a wide variety of fish species on the shallow reef.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: After multiple days in Alaska, it was time for the last trip out to sea. The crew got to experience the sights on this trip, like God Valley and others. And of course catch more Alaskan fish.

programme.title: We Caught That
programme.desc: Capt. Jason Dozier takes a trip out of Sebastian Inlet with Capt. Glyn Austin looking to catch Sharks, Tarpon, and anything else that bites.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Amateur Division reaches its climax at the Super Retriever Series Crown Championship. Top teams battle through the final rounds of Retriever Trials, where every point matters. In the end, one standout handler and dog team rises above the rest to be crowned Amateur SRS Crown Champions. At the same time, the excitement continues on the dock as fun-loving canine athletes compete for their own Crown victories in SRS Super Dock.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: For Capt. Justin Leake, sight fishing the beach is one of the most productive, and FUN ways to fish. When that doesn’t work, Capt. Todd Jones suggests fishing an artificial reef, and as it turns out, that’s where dinner lives.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Meredith McCord arrives in late spring and joins Capt. Justin Leake on the hunt for a fish she’s never caught before. Lo and behold, it’s a day fit for a king.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Frenette takes Blair off the coast of Louisiana to catch their limit of red snapper.

programme.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation
programme.desc: What happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: The Spirit of Mango
programme.desc: In Southern California, growers are pushing the limits of agriculture, using innovation and irrigation to cultivate mango in one of the country's most unlikely landscapes.

programme.title: Wild Palm Beaches
programme.desc: Featuring PBC ERM at the Loxahatchee Slough, the river center in Jupiter, Delaware Scrub Urban Natural Area and the art of nature segment with Lawrence Leyderman.

programme.title: Passport to The Palm Beaches
programme.desc: Features include Lion Country Safari's Lanterns & Lights, monkeying around with artist Serge Strosberg, and the Artwork of Reuben Hale gallery and sculpture garden.

programme.title: All Access Palm Beaches
programme.desc: Features include the Florida ASL Festival, Pickleball for All at the CMAA Therapeutic Recreation Complex, Phoenix Boxing Gym, the Jupiter Riverwalk, and The Therapeutic Alternative.

programme.title: Motorhead Garage
programme.desc: Dave Dobson hosts TV's only automotive aftermarket showcase, featuring the latest products to make vehicles look cooler, perform better, or last longer.

programme.title: RV There Yet?
programme.desc: Patrice and Kevin McCabe explore New Smyrna Beach, Florida -- they tour the Ponce de Leon Lighthouse, and watch a rocket launch.

programme.title: The RVers
programme.desc: Four-season RVing requires thoughtful planning and careful attention to the details; Peter and John share the trials and tribulations of two decades on the road.

programme.title: Americana Outdoors Presented by Garmin
programme.desc: On this episode of Americana Outdoors we learn more about hog hunting, how to hunt them, what to hunt them with and why eradicating hogs is so important for land management.

programme.title: Trophy Pond
programme.desc: Walt and his employee Noah catch big Florida bass in three different ponds.

programme.title: Bass Pro Shop's Collegiate Bass Series
programme.desc: Final day coverage of the AFTCO Collegiate Bass Open from Lake Dardanelle in Russellville, AR. The full field of over 280 teams competes for more than $20,000 in prizes and contingencies, as well as double points to count towards the Bass Pro Shops..

programme.title: Fishing and Hunting Texas
programme.desc: Host Wade Middleton and friends search for adventures in the outdoors.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: On this episode the guys are at the Rio Bendita to kick off turkey season.

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: It's turkey season and Max is in his element as he and Buck chase the thunderous calls of spring gobblers. Experience the heart-pounding excitement as these seasoned hunters match skills against nature's most cunning game birds.

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: Terry finishes up his hunt with Quill Lakes Outfitters in dramatic fashion with an epic waterfowl hunt.

programme.title: Scott Martin Challenge
programme.desc: Scott & Ryan Latinville vs Jake LaBelle & Brett Carnright in a classic 2v2 on Lake Champlain.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Laken's World Record Brownzilla - Laken (5 months pregnant w/ Molly Jean) and her husband Dillon target one particular monster jaw-dropping brown trout. Hats off to Jacob with Elite Fly Fishing for the incredible guiding and patience to land...

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Islamorada is a diver's dream, but we're going even deeper by exploring iconic wrecks, gliding over kaleidoscopic reefs, and shining a spotlight on the reef's unsung heroes: sponges. Later, we investigate new breakthroughs in coral restoration.

programme.title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
programme.desc: Westerly, Rhode Island; George Poveromo teams up with Cory Crochetiere to catch bluefin tuna off New England.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha disguises herself as the Golden Smurf Award to catch the Smurfs in order to use them as the main ingredient in her beauty cream. Vanity convinces her to try his recipe and before long, the wicked sorceress is covered with mud and sent careening over the hills into Gargamel's house.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel wants to create a monster. A horrible, gigantic creature, an awesome being that is going to destroy all the Smurfs! But Gargamel makes a slight mistake, and the result is going to astonish him and his cat Azrael.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: We all know Grouchy Smurf hates a lot of things. But one thing he hates more than anything else is water, when there is enough of it to drown in. You see, Grouchy can't swim. And when the Smurfs notice this peculiarity and try to teach him how to survive in water, the evil wizard Gargamel makes things a little more dangerous than they ought to be....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hefty Smurf meets an old Trolless in the forest, and the old crone begs him to relieve her of a red spot on her nose by... giving her a good kick here and now! Hefty half-heartedly obliges... And the result is a big surprise for him!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf is aghast. Sassette cannot read, and thus might be forever prevented from learning the pearls of wisdom collected in his book "Brainy Smurf's quotations"! He tries teaching her how to read. What she can read almost from the start is a formula to make all the books disappear! All the books in the world, including Gargamel's spells and Homnibus' books of remedies!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A strange little imp who is a master at games challenges the Smurfs to a contest. He turns the Smurflings into rigid game pieces and forces Grouchy, who never wins at games, into playing for the Smurflings' lives. Grouchy gains confidence, makes the right move, and frees the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Kaplowey Scroll
programme.desc: There is a terrifying magic word. When you direct the word at something or someone, you make it vanish into nothingness! Can the Smurfs undo its evil power before Gargamel gets hold of it?

programme.title: Educating Bigmouth
programme.desc: The Smurfs try to teach Bigmouth about romance, manners, and getting a job after Bignose kicks him out. He returns to her refined, but Bigteeth is courting Bignose. Bignose realizes what she was missing and takes Bigmouth back to live happily ever after.

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: An evil imp gives Smurfette dancing shoes and then tricks her into promising to marry him. All her little friends rush to her rescue and Papa Smurf magically puts the dancing shoes on the imp. He is forced to dance off into the night.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel's theft of the Fairies' gold almost brings a state of war between the Fairies and the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs must find a bunny family to pull their float in the Autumn Carnival. Gargamel sees his chance to capture the little blue people and disguises himself as a giant bunny. Is he going to catch all the Smurfs in one fell swoop?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: A dragon terrorizes the Village of the Smurfs. To put the dragon to rest, the Smurfs must find the noted Chinese traveler. Fortunately, Papa Smurf is able to understand the strange customs of the stranger, and even to speak a few words.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Little Sickly turns into a hero when he forgets his ailments and saves the rest of the Smurfs from the deadly forget-me flowers.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is that strange talking frog that Morlock the Wizard sends all of Prince Theodore's soldiers to catch? Is it a demon frog, as he says, or something else? Truth will out when Smurfette and the Smurflings meet the frog. They help to change this frog back into Prince Theodore himself, for he's been the victim of a spell cast by Morlock.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: Gormandizing Greedy
programme.desc: Greedy overdoes it. He's getting heavier and heavier until his weight puts him in jeopardy. The evil Gargamel is going to catch him... Can Greedy be saved by Papa Smurf?

programme.title: Dreamy's Pen Pals
programme.desc: When Dreamy decides to visit his friends, the Swoofs, Papa develops a potion to turn the Smurfs into alien-like creatures. But when the potion wears off to soon, Dreamy has to face the reality that the Swoofs do not exist. He is sad until a real alien arrives, returning Dreamy's letter that was delivered by mistake.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Bigmouth steals the Smurfs' winter food supply and Brainy concocts one of Papa Smurf's magic strength potions so he can fight the greedy giant. The super formula wears off, but Papa Smurf works a fast switch, replacing the food with rocks and Bigmouth is none the wiser.

programme.title: Clumsy Luck
programme.desc: The Smurfs learn about superstition when Clumsy breaks Vanity's mirror prior to a meteor shower. When a meteor falls on Clumsy's house, everyone attributes it to bad luck, but realize the foolishness of this philosophy when they see Clumsy was not in the house at the time.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy and Smurfette are captured by the wicked Bombast, who plans to exhibit them in his sideshow. Papa Smurf hurries to their rescue and using the bungling Gargamel for interference is able to rescue his Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sliding down a rainbow, a little winged horse loses a golden shoe. He meets the Smurfette and she helps him look for his lost horseshoe. They fall in love somehow, for who could be unmoved by the charm of a little orange horse... Or of a Smurfette?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil Maestro's magical paints have the power to transport his models onto canvas – forever! Papa Smurf directs Painter to switch his paints and before long, Maestro is enshrined in a picture next to his dream girl, Smurfette.

programme.title: Smurfing In Sign Language
programme.desc: The Smurfs meet a woodland elf, who teaches them sign language after Gargamel inflicts a no-speaking potion on them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel has found a new diabolical scheme to get rid of the Smurfs: a glittering powder that is going to reduce them to helpless laughter...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has hit on a revolutionary new idea: a sort of smurfless carriage that moves on railroad tracks. He calls it a railsmurfer and it makes for less work in the Village... until Gargamel chances upon it.

programme.desc: Balthazar the Enchanter is a man of vision. He knows that the times of alchemy are drawing to their end. The Smurfs will help to put things right after Little Thunder, a dinosaur, escapes through a gash in the fabric of time.

Well, it's Scruple, apprentice to the evil wizard Gargamel. And who should steal Gourdy from Scruple, if not Gargamel himself?

programme.desc: Curiosity brings Nosey Smurf to the lair of the Hag Sisters, who want to find the terrifying Sceptre of Yore... And Gargamel wants to cheat the two witches as he tries to destroy the Smurfs.

programme.desc: There isn't a River Smurf anymore: someone has frozen it near its source. The Smurfs go to the Emerald Empress' country to see what the trouble is, and they meet the Patchwork Bear as well as the Iron Pyrites...

programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil but incompetent wizard, tries to trick Esmeralda, the gypsy, into giving him a formula to catch the Smurfs. Of course the gypsy proves to be much smarter than Gargamel, and the Smurfs even more so.

programme.desc: Determined to fly over Smurf village to catch a Smurf to take to the Wizard's Convention, Gargamel invokes his Book of Spells to help him. A series of funny flying machine mishaps occur and Gargamel is once more the laughing stock of the Wizard's Convention.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Hogatha the witch promises Gargamel a magical whistle if he will introduce her to the warlock of her dreams. But they are both deceived by each other's trickery: Gargamel dresses up as the warlock, and Hogatha's magical whistle is only a birdcall.

programme.desc: Hogatha, the repulsive witch, captures the Smurfette. She wants to steal from the little blue beauty her golden hair. Can the Smurfs save their little female companion before it is too late? Can Hogatha grow hair like Smurfette's?

programme.desc: Brainy Smurf desperately wants to be more like Papa Smurf. Can a hair tonic be the answer? Can Gargamel be able to finally capture the Smurfs? Does wisdom really reside in a beard?

programme.desc: There is an evil power in the Titan's crown that Miner Smurf finds underground. And Greedy Smurf is the Smurf to fall victim to it. Then Gargamel comes up with some new schemes to destroy the Smurfs, and everything gets hopelessly tangled.

Brainy Smurf, self-appointed manager of the play, does not see it that way...

programme.desc: Gargamel has thrown in his slime pond so much poisonous muck that the water becomes enchanted and Gargamel, after falling in, suddenly finds himself much smaller that he would wish. Actually he is going to be so small that Papa Smurf will save him!

programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf recalls Dreamy's exciting voyage on the high seas and his gripping adventures with sea turtles, whales, desert islands... and pirates!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s kid brother Elliott happened to see Rikki’s mermaid tail in the water! He starts telling everyone he’s seen a sea monster. To cover up, the girls and Lewis start building a fake monster, to make people think it was all a hoax. But it’s too late – the whole town’s out looking for the famous “Dolphin City Monster”.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Vandals are carrying out a nasty plan: they have enlisted a terrible horde of stinging jellyfish to sow terror in the Bay. But the mermaids aren’t able to respond: Rikki grounded, wrongly accused of calling in a fire alarm at school, and Cleo has to help care for swimmers stung by the jellies.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A lunar eclipse makes Cleo lose her power!! Lewis tries to get it back using scientific methods, but he runs into a lot of trouble! Meanwhile, Teddy the kid turtle has got into trouble with Bernie and the other animals in the Bay after playing too many practical jokes.

programme.title: H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The famous explorer Stanley Finch, is back in Dolphin City, with an amazing hi-tech mini-submarine. He’s decided, this time, to find Edward the Cruel’s sunken galleon. Lewis gets enrolled as Stanley’s assistant in the little submarine, and tries to stop him. But he triggers an accident.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: The girls want Lewis to destroy Max’s research folder; Charlotte is getting too close. Reluctant to give it up, Lewis decides to take it back where it belongs - to Max. Suspicious, Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love - Gracie.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: There’s a fourth mermaid in town - Charlotte! Emma, Rikki and Cleo reluctantly have to deal with the newcomer. Charlotte is overjoyed, thinking this is the best thing that’s ever happened to her. No matter how much they all try to explain how tricky it is being a mermaid, Charlotte won’t listen.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Nate bullies Lewis, pretty much because he can, and when Nate’s jet-ski is damaged he blames Lewis, demanding payment. Meanwhile Emma, Rikki and Cleo continue to have problems accommodating Charlotte as a mermaid, she won’t listen to any advice. Charlotte takes their attempt to help as an attempt to boss her around.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: It’s Lewis’s birthday. Cleo and the others have some ideas how to celebrate but Charlotte quickly takes over and organises a surprise party for Lewis. Charlotte’s plans don’t seem to be about Lewis and Rikki eventually has enough and leaves. The party is at Charlotte’s house with all of Charlotte’s friends.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo is having some problems on the home front keeping her secret about being a mermaid. Meanwhile, Charlotte gives Lewis an ultimatum about spending time with Cleo and the others. When Lewis struggles to fob Cleo off, Charlotte steps in and bullies Cleo with her superior mermaid powers.

programme.title: H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, this full moon can remove mermaid powers for good. Cleo and Lewis are boyfriend and girlfriend again. Charlotte clashes with the girls, using her superior powers. When the girls come under another mermaid attack that night, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool in order to remove her powers.

programme.desc: Kat is upset when her parent’s ignore her 16th birthday and throws herself a huge party at their harbour front home as revenge. However chaos soon reigns when Tara spies Kat kissing Christian and realizes she can’t ignore her own feelings.

programme.desc: It is school camp time and Tara is ostracised by her friends and further humiliated when photos of her and Christian kissing keep appearing everywhere. Tensions culminate in a fight between Kat and Tara.
